from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u018/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        out = []
        start = 0
        for k in cuts:
            if k >= start:
                out.append((start, k))
            start = k + 1
        if start < n:
            out.append((start, n))
        return out
    rs, cs = spans(h, sep_rows), spans(w, sep_cols)
    panels = [(r0,r1,c0,c1) for r0,r1 in rs for c0,c1 in cs]
    def signal(p):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=p
        return sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
    source = max(panels, key=signal)
    r0,r1,c0,c1=source
    motif=[row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b,x,y in panels:
        if b-a == len(motif) and y-x == len(motif[0]):
            for i in range(b-a):
                for j in range(y-x):
                    out[a+i][x+j]=motif[i][j]
    return out
'''
